visual_requirements.description: Plain female human editorial rendering of Iranian goddess; no sourced body specification, costume or iconography asserted, fully opaque clothing.
Unspecified shrine beside a naturally flowing stream.
Dove and peacock as sacred associated animals, kept secondary to the goddess.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium PAINTERLY cinematic Mitoloka illustration of ANAHITA, Iranian goddess beside her stream-side shrine with the sacred dove and peacock.
ANATOMY: editorial adult female human rendering of the goddess, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs; fully opaque broad layered drapery, plain costume with no historical iconography, crown, jewelry, weapon or symbol. One real dove and one real peacock, her documented sacred animals. [anahita-c01, anahita-c06]
MOMENT: surging forward in a sweeping forceful step toward the very low viewer, torso leaning across the square with a stern focused downward gaze and tightly set jaw; her empty near hand opens with physically natural five fingers toward the foreground, far arm stays bent close to the body. The dove takes wing beside her face; the peacock raises its wide real feather fan behind her other shoulder. This is an overwhelming approach, not standing, posing for a portrait, smiling or gazing neutrally.
POWER: no documented magical effect and no hydrokinesis; the stream flows naturally, birds move normally. Awe arises only from physical approach, severe gaze, natural sunlight and her documented sacred animal association. [anahita-c05, anahita-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme close foreshortened three-quarter bust from below, face occupies the upper central third, broad shoulders dominate, near hand at bottom-left; normal body size without tiny humans or any cosmic enlargement. The severe face, dove wing and peacock fan are large and clear at 200 pixels; no distant subject.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single hard warm side shaft through the shrine doorway, deeply carved walnut shadows across the brow and face, natural rim on real feather edges, ordinary ambient stream spray.
SURFACE: thick opaque heavy cloth in broad energetic painterly folds, rough damp stone and richly detailed physical feathers. Visible paint texture and bold directional brushstrokes; do not make a photographic fashion portrait.
SETTING: a deliberately unspecified simple dark shrine threshold beside a flowing stream, only rough plain stone and natural water, no temple ornaments or invented historic features. [anahita-c05]
MOOD: reverent but overpowering authority, majestic and stern, active and unsettling through intensity, never an ordinary pretty woman, calm decorative portrait or monstrous goddess.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no crown, horns, weapon, magical water or invented iconography; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
prompts.B:
ONE original square premium PAINTERLY cinematic Mitoloka illustration of ANAHITA, Iranian goddess in a commanding stride at her shrine beside naturally running water, with her sacred dove and peacock.
ANATOMY: plain adult female human editorial representation of the goddess, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs. Entirely opaque heavy layered ceremonial drapery in dark slate and antique warm ivory, broad majestic folds without any crown, jewelry, weapon or sacred symbol. Appearance and dress are editorial and not an assertion of historical iconography. One real dove and one real peacock are associated sacred animals. [anahita-c01, anahita-c06]
MOMENT: turning in a forceful diagonal descending stride along the waterside threshold, her near shoulder and bent knee directed toward the low viewer while her stern commanding face turns down over the shoulder. Her empty hands gather the dense heavy opaque cloth close to her body so the stride reads as deliberate ritual authority, not climbing or struggling. A dove launches normally across the upper dark doorway; the peacock beside her lower robe opens its full real feather fan.
POWER: no hydrokinesis, no supernatural water, no magical radiance; stream watercourses flow naturally downhill beside the shrine. Awe comes from the documented goddess, sacred birds, forceful movement and extreme low viewpoint. [anahita-c05, anahita-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: strong oblique low view, nearly full-body compressed diagonal framing, foreshortened near knee in the bottom foreground and the stern face large in the upper-left third. Broad shoulder-to-hem drapery dominates almost the entire square, normal bodily scale with no comparison people or colossal claims. Distinct from an upper-body hand-reaching portrait: hands remain close to cloth, full stride and diagonally sweeping robe carry the movement.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one powerful low warm slant of evening light across the moving shoulder and stream, deep dark walnut shadows, ordinary splashes at the edge of the naturally running water.
SURFACE: broad bold painterly brushstrokes, thick dense opaque cloth, damp plain stone, richly physical bird feathers; solemn ceremonial drapery, not everyday tunic or photographic fashion.
SETTING: a deliberately unspecified plain dark shrine entrance next to a natural rocky watercourse, no decorated cult objects or invented historic architectural features. [anahita-c05]
MOOD: reverent overwhelming authority, stern and imposing, goddess in a deliberate physical action; never monstrous, smiling, neutral decorative portrait or ordinary woman by a stream.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no crown, horns, weapon, magical water or invented iconography; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
